statement: An employer required to file Form 941 must file it by the last day of the month that follows the end of each calendar quarter (April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31); if timely deposits were made in full payment of the quarter's taxes, the filing date extends 10 days, and a due date falling on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday moves to the next business day.
caveat: The quarterly return is separate from the deposit schedule (monthly or semiweekly), which has its own — usually earlier — deadlines; some employers file Form 944 annually instead. Verify against the live instructions; this repo does not calculate or extend the deadline.
